role_place: Christian speaker in an epistolary debate with the Muslim al-Hashimi; the text sets the exchange at the court of al-Ma'mun (early 9th c.).
why_relevant: Earliest text among those I checked (Syriac, Arabic-Christian, Coptic, Armenian, Jewish; not Greek or Latin) that names Aisha and points to her youth ('youngest of his wives') as part of its criticism of the marriage; no number is given.
fame: Known mainly to specialists in Christian Arabic apologetics; William Muir's 1882 translation made it known to English readers. Authorship and date are disputed.
community: Arabic-speaking Christian (confession not stated in the text)
